response.sql: WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(humepct) as overall_mean FROM scanenvironment WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL), above_avg_equipment AS (SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity, oa.overall_mean FROM equipment_avg ea CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE ea.avg_humidity > oa.overall_mean AND ea.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL AND oa.overall_mean IS NOT NULL), group_stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as group_mean_value FROM above_avg_equipment) SELECT aa.equipref, aa.avg_humidity, aa.avg_humidity - aa.overall_mean as exceeds_overall, aa.avg_humidity - gs.group_mean_value as exceeds_group_mean FROM above_avg_equipment aa CROSS JOIN group_stats gs ORDER BY exceeds_group_mean IS NULL ASC, exceeds_group_mean DESC LIMIT 10
